_comment: CAST v9 A1 — Egress audit-record classification data (log-only; advisory).
_thesis: Make 'know what leaves the machine' OBSERVABLE (log-only). The sentinel RECORDS every off-machine-bound tool call locally (the record-deepening thesis) and warns advisory-only on sensitive content — it never blocks or asks. Native permissions.deny/ask handle coarse tool+domain access; this layer adds local audit + content-sensitivity + credential-read correlation.
_mode_note: No enforcement mode exists: the sentinel is log-only/advisory. The advise/ask/strict modes + CAST_EGRESS_ENFORCEMENT env + cast-cli.json egress_enforcement were removed in v9 W1b (they never fired). This file holds POLICY DATA (classification) only.

mcp_servers._doc: Per-server cloud-bound classification. Transport (stdio vs http) is NOT a reliable signal: github uses local stdio (npx) yet calls api.github.com. Key = the <server> segment of mcp__<server>__<tool>.
mcp_servers._cast_record_note: cast-record: stdio, local cast.db reads only, ships with CAST — see scripts/cast-mcp-server.py

credential_path_globs._doc: File paths that, when Read (or cat'd in Bash), count as a credential read. Logged always; escalated only if correlated with an egress event in the same session (compound detection = Ed's build).

bash_network_commands._doc: Bash binaries that can move data off-machine. git push is intentionally OMITTED (already gated by pre-tool-guard.sh CAST_PUSH_OK). Detection heuristics + exfil-pipe parsing are Ed's build — see docs/v9-a1-egress-sentinel.md Surface 3.

safelist_hosts._doc: Hosts/domains that suppress ADVISORY noise (still recorded, never warned unless sensitive content is detected). Loopback is always safe.

telemetry._doc: OTEL/telemetry exporters pointing off-machine. localhost/127.0.0.1 endpoints are local feeds (allowed by the thesis: OTEL is only ever a LOCAL feed).
